objective: Compare decision loss for adaptive/fixed evidence budgets using unseen synthetic seeds, penalizing false confirmations, false rejections, abstentions and observations.

definition.fixed: Collect fixed n in {80,120,160,240}, classify via SG029 median-pairwise trend and thresholds
definition.adaptive: Check every 40 observations starting 80, stop after two consecutive equal non-unresolved classifications; otherwise unresolved at 240
definition.cost_aware: Check every 40 starting 80; stop at n>=120 after 2 consistent decided classifications and slope >0.0036 or <0.0014; otherwise unresolved at 240; heuristic, not proven expected-cost optimization

stream.first_240: SG027-style synthetic stream discarded as already observed
stream.fresh_additional: Continuation 240..479 from per-seed simulated AR1 ±0.23 innovations, rho 0.72, +3 step at t120, ±7 impulses at t42/87/173/211
stream.noise_assumptions: Seeded Python Random, known uniform innovations and AR1 correlation.

calibration.pre_freeze_status: Exploratory only; showed fixed80 high errors and adaptive lowest cost in pilot

measure: Count false confirmations and false rejections
holdout.stop: No policy or cost changes once frozen

scope_limits: Heuristic cost-aware policy, not formal Bayes-optimal decision rule
Reused synthetic distribution and artificial loss units, not external validation
One sample stream can be evaluated under all policies; comparison paired, not independently randomized
Accuracy can differ under unseen drift slopes/noise models
